package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type HybridApplication interface {
	CreateHybridLearningIntent(context.Context, string, domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error)
	GetHybridLearningIntent(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error)
	ApplyHybridConsequence(context.Context, domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error)
}
